analysis.buttonHint: Session charts from the official timing: race trace, lap-by-lap pace and tyres
analysis.title: Lap analysis
analysis.noSpoilersHint: On: the charts only use data up to the player's current time. Turn it off to see the whole session.

selection.label: Selected
selection.clearFollowing: Clear the selection of {driver} and stop following it

analysis.legend: Drivers: show or hide their series

card.lapPos: {x}: P{pos} at the line, +{gap} s behind the leader
card.markExcluded: excluded: pit stop, SC, VSC, red flag or lap 1
card.pitIn: It entered the pit lane on that lap.
card.nothingAfter: No line crossing after that in the data; the source doesn't say why.
card.click: Click: go to the start of {x}
card.clickThat: Click: go to the start of that lap
card.goThat: Go to the start of that lap

analysis.noLaps: No data: this session has no timed laps.
analysis.nothingYet: No data up to this moment yet. Move the player forward or turn off «No spoilers».
analysis.identify: Each dot is a lap; the second driver of each team uses squares and «+» (■ □ +) instead of circles and «✕». Each driver's code sits next to their last dot, at its height, when it doesn't overlap another; otherwise the legend names it (the selected car's code is always shown). With a triangle, that dot is off the scale. Hover over a point or a name in the legend to see whose it is (on a touch screen, tap the dot or press and hold the name: a short tap on the name shows or hides it).
analysis.identifyLap: Each series carries its driver's code to the right of its last value, at its height, when it doesn't overlap another; otherwise the legend names it, in the same top-to-bottom order (the selected car's code is always shown). The second driver of each team is dashed. With a triangle, the last value is off the scale. Hover over a line, a code or a name in the legend to highlight it and see its card (on a touch screen, tap the line or press and hold its name in the legend: a short tap on the name shows or hides it). A series ending in a bar belongs to a car that stopped crossing the line: the leader did three more laps without it crossing, or the whole session is shown and it didn't cross again after the leader's last lap. The legend groups them separately, with the lap of their last crossing; the source doesn't say why they stopped.
analysis.identifyPaceLap: Each series carries its driver's code to the right of its last value, at its height, when it doesn't overlap another; otherwise the legend names it (the selected car's code is always shown). The second driver of each team is dashed. With a triangle, the last value is off the scale. Hover over a line, a code or a name in the legend to highlight it and see its card (on a touch screen, tap the line or press and hold its name in the legend: a short tap on the name shows or hides it). A series ending in a bar belongs to a car that stopped crossing the line: the leader did three more laps without it crossing, or the whole session is shown and it didn't cross again after the leader's last lap. Its name in the legend says which lap it reaches; the source doesn't say why it stopped.

raceTrace.chart: Race trace: gap to the leader at each line crossing, lap by lap
raceTrace.axis: Gap to the leader at the line (s), per lap
raceTrace.basis: Difference between the official line-crossing times of each lap, with no fuel correction or smoothing. The leader of each lap is at the top. A lapped car can be more than a lap behind; a car that stops crossing the line ends its series.
raceTrace.onlyRace: The race trace only makes sense in races and sprints: in practice and qualifying every driver runs on their own and there is no on-track gap to compare lap by lap. See «Pace» or «Tyres».

pace.chartLap: Pace: official time of each lap, per lap
pace.chartTime: Pace: official time of each lap, by the session time when it ends
pace.basis: Official lap times, with no fuel correction or smoothing. Laps that are not useful to compare pace are marked, not removed.
pace.markExcluded: ○ □ excluded: pit, SC, VSC, red flag or lap 1
pace.noTime: No official time: {n} lap (not drawn) | No official time: {n} laps (not drawn)
pace.lap1: Lap 1: no official time (start from the grid).
pace.noTrackStatus: No per-lap track status: laps under SC, VSC or red flag cannot be marked.
pace.outside: {n} lap is outside the pace scale. | {n} laps are outside the pace scale.
pace.nothingShown: Pick a driver in the legend to see their pace.

stints.label: Tyre stints per driver
stints.basisRace: One stint per set of tyres according to the timing, from its first to its last lap. Press one to go to its start.
stints.basisRuns: One stint per run on track according to the timing, from pit exit to pit entry. Press one to go to its start.
stints.tyreLifeHint: Laps on the tyre set according to the timing (TyreLife). A used set can carry laps from other sessions (practice or qualifying), so it is not the age in this session.
